description: Explicit Banking77 → Amazon-taxonomy mapping. 13 of 77 Banking77 intents have a clear semantic analog in our 11-category Amazon taxonomy. 4 Amazon categories (order_cancellation, return_or_exchange, product_issue, device_and_digital_support) have no banking analog.

card_arrival.rationale: 'When will my card arrive?' is the banking analog of 'Where is my order?' — neutral status inquiry without complaint.

pending_transfer.rationale: Asking about a pending transaction status is information-seeking, not yet a complaint — maps to order_status_inquiry.

transfer_timing.rationale: 'How long does a transfer take?' is a timing/ETA inquiry, equivalent to asking for an estimated delivery window.

card_delivery_estimate.rationale: KEY HARD-PAIR ANALOG: 'Why hasn't my card arrived? I was told it would take 3-5 days.' The card_delivery_estimate Banking77 intent parallels shipping_delay_complaint exactly — a promised ETA that wasn't met. Contrasted with card_arrival (neutral inquiry).

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.rationale: Sent but not received by the other party — a delivery failure complaint analog.

failed_transfer.rationale: Transfer initiated but not completed — the banking equivalent of a shipment that never left the warehouse.

request_refund.rationale: Direct semantic analog — customer wants money returned.

refund_not_showing_up.rationale: 'My refund was processed but hasn't appeared in my account' — the banking equivalent of 'where's my refund?' follow-ups.

transaction_charged_twice.rationale: Duplicate charge complaint — customer expects one of the charges to be reversed, equivalent to an unauthorised-charge refund request.

passcode_forgotten.rationale: Exact analog — locked out of account due to forgotten credential.

pin_blocked.rationale: Card/account access blocked — equivalent to suspended/locked account.

compromised_card.rationale: Security breach requiring account control — maps to the 'my account was hacked' variant of account_access.

extra_charge_on_statement.rationale: Unexplained charge on statement without a specific actionable request — best fit is the general complaint catch-all.
